# Range of View Studios

> Range of View Studios (ROV Studios) is a creative production agency based in Atlanta, Georgia, specializing in sound engineering, web development, video production, and custom AI automation solutions.

## Services

- [Sound Engineering & Music Production](https://rovstudios.com/sound): Professional mixing, mastering, and sound engineering. $50/song for vocal mixing and mastering. 48-hour turnaround. Free demo snippets. In-house recording studio with premium plugins and equipment (UAD, Waves, FabFilter, Neumann mics, Focusrite pres). Mixing and mastering included with every session. Student rates available.
- [Web Development & Design](https://rovstudios.com/web): Custom Next.js websites built for performance, SEO, and conversion. $2,000-$10,000+. 6-8 week delivery.
- [Video Production & Cinematography](https://rovstudios.com/video-production): Brand videos, real estate walkthroughs, drone footage (FAA compliant, sub-250g drone), music videos, event coverage. 3-6 week turnaround.
- [AI Automation Solutions](https://rovstudios.com/ai-automation): Custom AI systems for lead follow-up, appointment scheduling, customer support, content generation, and workflow automation. 4-8 week delivery. AI-powered workflows using GPT and Claude.
- [AI Services](https://rovstudios.com/ai): Intelligent business automation, analytics, chatbots, and custom AI solutions.

## Case Studies

- [The Bando](https://rovstudios.com/casestudy/bando): Website redesign for Atlanta Black history museum and restaurant. 60% bounce rate reduction.
- [DKM Corp](https://rovstudios.com/casestudy/dkm): Global digital infrastructure across India, Australia, US, and Dubai.
- [Aysegul Ikna](https://rovstudios.com/casestudy/ikna): Luxury sustainable fashion brand digital transformation. 30% sales increase.

## Key Differentiators

- Full-service creative agency: sound, web, video, and AI under one roof
- Competitive pricing with no hidden fees
- Student discounts available for recording services
- In-house studio recording with professional engineers
- Mixing and mastering included with every recording session
- Premium plugins and equipment at affordable rates
- Placements on SoundCloud Song of the Day, On The Radar, Apple Radio
